name: prd-designz
description: Product design and UI prototype skills for new-product design direction, existing-project UI skill generation, and project-consistent prototyping.

interface.shortDescription: Design specs, project UI skill generation, and prototype workflows.
interface.longDescription: PRD Designz bundles design-md for new-product DESIGN.md and HTML prototype generation, project-ui-skill-builder for extracting an existing project's UI tokens and component patterns into a reusable project-specific prototype skill, and project-ui-prototyper for using those project UI rules to generate PRD-to-prototype or sketch-to-prototype outputs.
defaultPrompt: Use design-md to create a DESIGN.md and high-fidelity prototype for a new product or page direction.
Use project-ui-skill-builder to extract an existing project's UI tokens and generate a project-specific prototype skill.
Use project-ui-prototyper to turn a PRD, page request, flow, screenshot, wireframe, or sketch into a prototype that matches an existing project UI system.
Generate prototypes that follow either a new design direction or an extracted project UI system.
